programme.title: Computer Science and Technology (Computer Science Division, Department of Computer Science and Technology) - Chinese and English Programs
programme.teaching_language: Chinese-English taught (listed under 'Divisions (Chinese and English Programs)'; HSK 5 required plus English proficiency)
programme.quote: Computer Science Department of Computer Science and Technology Computer Science and Technology Physics
programme.how_found: Search led to international.join-tsinghua.edu.cn (Tsinghua Undergraduate Admissions, international applicants); Divisions page lists Computer Science division -> Department of Computer Science and Technology -> major Computer Science and Technology (official equivalent of 计算机科学与技术). Campus taken from the admissions office address 'Haidian District, Beijing, 100084'.

value.hsk_level: HSK 5 or above, scores above 60 in each of Listening, Reading and Writing
value.english_test: official English test (e.g. TOEFL/IELTS) required for non-native speakers, no minimum score published

english.quote: Applicants must demonstrate Chinese language proficiency at HSK Level 5 or above, with scores above 60 in each of the following categories: Listening, Reading, and Writing.
english.how_found: Admission > Eligibility page, section 4.2 For Chinese-English-Taught Programs.
english.notes: The binding language requirement is Chinese (HSK), recorded here per instructions. Section 4.2.3 also says: 'Those whose native language is not English must provide official English language proficiency test results (e.g. TOEFL/IELTS/others)' but no minimum TOEFL/IELTS score is published. HSK waiver possible only for native Chinese speakers or graduates of Chinese-medium high schools (not the case for NIS).

value.description: No published grade/GPA minimum or test cut-off; holistic evaluation (document screening + Comprehensive Assessment). Academic performance shown via transcripts, national graduation exam certificates, optional international tests (CSCA/SAT/ACT/A-Level/AP/IB), Olympiad awards.

gpa.quote: Admission decisions are made based on a holistic evaluation of academic performance, language proficiency, supporting materials, and the results of the Comprehensive Assessment.
gpa.how_found: Admission > Application Procedures, section 3 Admission Decision and Offer; Eligibility page section 3 lists academic evidence without thresholds.
gpa.notes: Eligibility only asks for 'outstanding academic performance'. FAQ says CSCA scores are not required (stated for the 2026 intake). Divisions page: Computer Science requires high school Physics plus a strong foundation in mathematics and English.

deadline.quote: Online application (Beijing Time): 8:00 AM November 21, 2026—5:00 PM February 28, 2027 The Second Round result will be issued by: Early May , 2027
deadline.notes: Final deadline (second round) 2027-02-28 17:00 Beijing time. Earlier first round: 8:00 AM September 30, 2026 - 5:00 PM November 20, 2026 (results January 2027). Chinese-English programmes may apply in either round. Comprehensive Assessment dates announced later.

value.academic_year: not stated on page (published on the 2027-intake admissions site; assumed applicable to 2027/28 entry)

tuition.how_found: Admission > Fees page, Chinese-English Taught Programs group whose tuition is listed as '30,000.00 / Per Year'.
tuition.notes: The fees table groups items 1-14 (incl. '4. Computer Science') followed by '30,000.00 / Per Year' (RMB). The page does not name an academic year; it sits alongside 2027-dated Schedule/Eligibility pages. Other costs: application fee RMB 800 (non-refundable), insurance RMB 800/year, accommodation separate.

value.name: Tsinghua University International Undergraduate Freshmen Scholarship

scholarship_exists.quote: Outstanding international freshmen who apply for and are awarded the scholarship through the application system will receive financial support for their first academic year, including full-tuition, half-tuition, and partial-tuition scholarships.
scholarship_exists.notes: Covers first academic year only (full/half/partial tuition). Page states 'In 2026, approximately 45% of international undergraduate freshmen were awarded this scholarship.' Applied for via the application system. Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC, via embassy, Type A) also listed but is not university-run.

scholarship_international.quote: In 2026, approximately 45% of international undergraduate freshmen were awarded this scholarship.
scholarship_international.notes: The scholarship is specifically for international undergraduate freshmen.

access_notes: Admissions site is international.join-tsinghua.edu.cn (Tsinghua Undergraduate Admissions; join-tsinghua.edu.cn is Tsinghua's official admissions domain, linked to www.tsinghua.edu.cn) - pages are static HTML, fetched without issue.
Fees page contains no academic-year label; tuition year inferred only from site context.
Raw HTML splits some words with spans (e.g. 'Freshm e n'), so quotes were chosen from contiguous text and verified against tag-stripped page text.
